title: Venezuela earthquakes kill 920 people as international rescue teams arrive
description: Hundreds are still feared trapped under the rubble, as families desperate for news.

title: Heat Wave Takes Toll on Europe’s Infrastructure, Too
description: The devastating heat wave has exposed weaknesses in the continent’s infrastructure, much of it built for a cooler climate that no longer exists.

title: Islanders have so much to weigh before letting Anders Lee walk in free agency
description: The door is not closed, not yet, not officially, on Anders Lee to return to the Islanders. No one is eager to see the captain leave.

title: U.S. strikes Iran in response to a drone attack on a ship
description: The U.S. struck Iran on Friday in response to a drone attack a day earlier on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz. It's the most significant test yet to an interim understanding reached a week ago by the two countries.

title: Vida o muerte: Así fue la fiesta y la desgracia de la afición en una jornada clave del Mundial
description: Franceses y noruegos inauguraron la fiesta; Cabo Verde no pudo esconder su felicidad máxima, al igual que España, pero por los uruguayos no había más que caras largas tras la derrota y eliminación. Así viven los fanáticos la Copa del Mundo.

title: Análisis Experto: Francia podría tener un punto débil y España todavía no convence
description: Nuestros expertos analizaron a Francia, la selección más dominante en los primeros partidos, pero detectaron que hay un detalle que podría atormentar a los ‘Galos’. Por otro lado, aunque España fue líder, su funcionamiento sigue sin ser el esperado.

title: US strikes on Iran test fragile ceasefire
description: The US has struck Iran for the first time since the two sides reached a Memorandum of Understanding on June 17.

title: Fireworks explosion likely caused by  cigarette smoker obliterates three homes, injures 5 people
description: A gargantuan firework detonation likely caused by smokers obliterated several homes and injured five people, including three firefighters, rattling an island community in western Washington State this week, according to authorities.

title: The massive Jaylen Brown price Celtics are asking for in trade
description: It may cost a fortune to trade for Jaylen Brown.

title: Home Office to introduce new asylum routes to UK
description: The home secretary said "capped safe and legal" routes would help to restore confidence in the asylum system.

title: New Mexico AG launches criminal investigation into DEA over allegations agents let fentanyl flood state
description: New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez announced a criminal investigation into allegations that the DEA allowed fentanyl pills to reach communities.

title: Isaiah Hartenstein signing new three-year, $75 million Thunder contract
description: The Thunder had a big decision to make in settling their frontcourt, and they've locked down their man in the middle, which wasn't always a guarantee heading into the season.

title: ¡Apareció Kevin De Bruyne! Bélgica firma la goleada ante Nueva Zelanda
description: Kevin De Bruyne apareció al minuto 66 para marcar el tercer gol de Bélgica. Tras una gran asistencia de Leandro Trossard, el mediocampista definió con calidad para encaminar la goleada sobre Nueva Zelanda.

title: España elimina a Uruguay y Cabo Verde hace historia
description: España venció a Uruguay y aseguró el liderato del Grupo H. Cabo Verde empató con Arabia Saudita y avanzó a dieciseisavos en su primera Copa del Mundo, mientras Francia cerró líder de su sector.

title: Doblete de Leandro Trossard para encaminar el triunfo de Bélgica
description: Leandro Trossard firmó su doblete al minuto 50 tras aprovechar un rebote dentro del área. El belga insistió después de un rechazo defensivo y amplió la ventaja de su selección ante Nueva Zelanda.

title: Francia golea a Noruega con triplete de Dembélé y España elimina a Uruguay
description: Francia logra la clasificación perfecta de 9 puntos gracias a la victoria ante Noruega y España también clasifica a 16avos de final, eliminando a la Uruguay de Marcelo Bielsa

title: French shoppers clash over air conditioners as deadly heatwave sweeps Europe
description: Footage shows shoppers elbowing their way through the crowd and clambering over one another to snatch portable air conditioners and fans from the shelves.

title: JD Vance tells Bill Maher how ‘America wins’ with or without Iran deal
description: Vice President JD Vance argued during an interview with Bill Maher Friday that "America wins" even if Iran refuses to sign a deal that would end the war.

title: Cape Verde becomes tiniest nation to make World Cup knockouts
description: Cape Verde erupted in celebration after the national team qualified for the World Cup knockout stage and made history.

title: Minnesota school board member under fire after saying dogs should urinate on ‘White corpses’ in cemeteries
description: Allen is facing federal felony charges in connection with the Jan. 18 invasion of Cities Church in St. Paul where she was part of an anti-Immigration and Customs Enforcement protest where she and others stormed the church during services.

title: ¡Entró y marcó! Romelu Lukaku sentencia la goleada de Bélgica
description: Romelu Lukaku solo necesitó un minuto en el campo para hacerse presente en el marcador. El delantero belga conectó de cabeza un centro preciso y firmó el 4-1 sobre Nueva Zelanda.

title: Elijah Just descuenta para Nueva Zelanda ante Bélgica
description: lijah Just aprovechó un tiro de esquina al minuto 84 para marcar el descuento de Nueva Zelanda frente a Bélgica en la Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026.

title: Polygamous sect leader convicted of abuse charges after girls found in trailer on Arizona highway
description: Police stopped Samuel Bateman’s vehicle as he was driving through Flagstaff and found three girls inside, who were ages 11 to 14 at the time.
